summary.zh-CN: 卷积用一个较小的[[term:convolution-kernel|卷积核]]在输入的空间位置上滑动。每到一个位置，就把局部输入与卷积核逐元素相乘并求和，得到输出中的一个元素；同一组卷积核[[term:model-parameter|参数]]在不同位置重复使用。
summary.en-US: A convolution slides a small [[term:convolution-kernel|kernel]] across spatial positions in the input. At each position, it multiplies the local input and kernel element by element and sums the products to produce one output element; the same kernel [[term:model-parameter|parameters]] are reused at different positions.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 卷积通过局部连接和空间参数共享，高效提取可在不同位置出现的模式。
coreConclusion.en-US: Convolution efficiently extracts patterns that can appear at different positions through local connections and spatial parameter sharing.
